negative_reviews.author: Richard
negative_reviews.text: I’ve been to this restaurant in other cities and this was by far the worst of them all. I usually like this place because of their good food but the service today was terrible. We were served by Mia W, I don’t know if she was special needs or just really bad at her job but she got our order wrong about 4 times, we were brought the wrong drink, when we asked her for a food item ON THE MENU whilst pointing at it so she could see what we wanted - she looked incredibly confused as if she’d never heard of the food before, and every time we spoke to her she stared at us very rudely with her mouth wide open like we were speaking a different language and we often had to repeat ourselves whenever we spoke to her (we all have regular British accents and the other workers there understood us perfectly fine). The sushi also took over an hour to arrive after we ordered it, which I don’t blame her for because obviously there’s nothing she could do about that. When we finished our food, we asked Mia for the bill and for a box to pack the rest of the sushi so we could take it home, she said okay and came back with the card machine and no box. We then showed her our Maki & Ramen loyalty card for her to scan, and she just looked at us with her mouth wide open and said “we don’t do student discounts”. so we said “this isn’t a student id, it’s a loyalty card for this restaurant” and she just stared at us for 5 minutes and said she needs to get her manager to do this. She then returned with her manager (still no box) and the manager scanned the card with no problems. We then asked her for a box again and she looked even more confused then we had to clarify (for the 3rd time) that we wanted a box for our food and then she finally gave us a box. Overall, the food was alright but the server was rude and not very good at taking orders.

issues: Deliveroo raised a food poisoning case by email but has decided not to take it further, and the team has been reminded to keep hot and cold food separate.
An order was recorded as inaccurate after the driver left two bags at the store; a second driver could not be sent because the order had already been closed.
Prep time rose because the kitchen was short staffed over the bank holiday weekend and is expected to return to normal this week.
The site is considering dropping to two front of house team members from Monday to Thursday from the start of November to get ahead of quiet midweek trade.
The site ran out of Sprite again over the weekend, which caused the drink variance, and Dave has been told to order an extra case when in doubt.
Google review volume is low and the existing incentive is not working, as the team were not interested in paintball, so an alternative voucher incentive is being sought around Sheffield.
A guest left a review calling a member of staff special needs; it has been reported by front of house and by other units but Google has not taken it down, and the team member concerned is very upset.
The manager on shift had taken food off the bill so knew it was a problem table, and has been reminded to resolve issues with the table before guests leave.
Mihi has requested a transfer, understood to be to Birmingham, and Arthur has spoken to Sophie about it, so another sushi chef is needed for Christmas as the remaining chef cannot start before 5.
One more part time front of house member is also being sought for Christmas.
Dave has requested four weeks off in November for his wedding and honeymoon, which cannot be approved in full given Christmas trade, and the same hours cannot be guaranteed on his return.
The bar standard at the site is a concern, and the change in the bar team is seen as an opportunity to reinforce new standards and bring new people in.

Front of house are not completing end of night compliance checks consistently and the kitchen is completing only part of its checklist, so a new handover layout has been posted in the front of house group chat.
All maintenance issues are logged and verified with Francesca, including a glass washer socket that keeps tripping and the booth tables, with Ethan attending the following day.

A discount for Sheffield Steelers season ticket holders has been proposed, as the arena next door drives a large volume of weekend trade that could otherwise go to nearby competitors; this was agreed subject to the arena's consent and the restaurant being featured on their website or promotional channels.

There are no arrangements in place for the student night at the site, although a ten per cent discount for the night was mentioned in the group chat, and the banners and materials for it have not arrived.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): A new stock monitoring system has been introduced, using an API link to Kobas to send a daily email reminder each morning covering the main food items, with drinks to be added later.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): The stock reminder system only works if sites stop blind matching in the store account and input every delivery on the day it is received, otherwise the reminders will be inaccurate.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Vouchers now have to be redeemed by the customer through the loyalty app rather than handed over at the till, which means event level discount codes can no longer be tracked.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): The operational mindset is shifting away from cutting labour cost towards maximising revenue and profit, as constant cost cutting is burning staff out and damaging service and morale.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): B2B event notes have been issued to sites and the staffing list for the Freshers Fair events is being finalised, so managers need to check their calendars and make sure enough manpower is arranged for those dates.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Unannounced site visits are expected at the end of the month, with Michael touring all sites and observing without warning, so standards need to be held.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): The Deliveroo promotion includes a very limited number of one hundred per cent off bills, likely only one or two per site, and there is no cap on party size when one is redeemed.
